identity: A physics multiple-choice question bank (momentum, resistance and conductivity, sound, action-reaction, units, electromagnetism). Twenty items, each on one <NL>-delimited line as [stem][option x4]. Register = §S, pure layout segmentation, same shape as doc_afd0d91483b4.
law: Layout only. One line = one item = one stem segment plus four option segments; every token before a <NL> and the final token are free boundaries. The stem swallows everything up to the point where the options start branching, no matter how long and no matter what it contains (S1). Connectives inside a stem or inside an option never cut (S2): فكان and فإن sit inside stems, و sits inside options. Numbers and stripped unit strings are never split (A2): 0 5, 1 5, 2 ك ع, كغم م ث.
reasoning: Item 1 is the stress test and the reason S1 matters: its stem runs 46 tokens (@0-@45) through two coordinated verbs (بدأتا وتحركتا), a bare asyndetic clause (تأثرت كال من السيارتين), a علما بأن parenthetical and a وعليه فإن resumptive - all of which would be cuts in running prose and none of which is a cut here, exactly like the 55-token stem in doc_1c49614cd6bc. It ends at هي @45, the copula that hands off to the options. Item 5 (@124 تكون) and item 10 (@267 الحركية) are the same shape, with فكان/فإن inside. The stem/option split is fixed by where the options stop sharing material: item 17 keeps جسيمات inside the options because the word is repeated four times (@403 @407 @412 @417), which is the doc_afd0d91483b4 الحمض case rather than the doc_87ac286b6785 زيت case, so the stem stops at the preposition على @402. Three items carry a literally duplicated option - الطاقة/الطاقة (item 3), كغم م ث twice (item 11), تنعدم عندها المقاومة twice (item 14), في عدة نقاط مشتركه twice (item 13) - which I read as scrape artifacts rather than as evidence of a three-option item, because every other item in the bank has exactly four; that keeps the option count uniform at four throughout. Item 15 option 1 is 0 5 م (0.5 م) and item 12 option 3 is 2 ك ع: the digits stay inside their option. 100 boundaries over 20 items, 5 per item.
